name: Secret Pet Playmate
source: Unleash your inner fighter and take on the role of the schools most feared delinquent! No one tells you what to do—until the quietest girl in your class discovers your secret passion for writing and illustrating! The two of you join forces to keep your stories safe and explore a world of trust and obedience together. Will you be able to keep up your tough exterior while becoming someones pet?
